topic: how Spotify pays out about seventy cents of every dollar to the music industry but musicians still say they earn little
storyAngle: Most of the money leaves Spotify, but it goes to labels and publishers, not straight to artists.
doNotClaim: The ~70% goes to rights holders (labels/publishers), not directly to artists.
Do not state a per-stream payout.

facts.claim: Spotify says it pays out about 70% of every dollar generated from music to the music industry (2022 data); about 66% was reported for 2021.
say: about seventy cents on the dollar

facts.claim: That payout goes to rights holders (record labels, distributors and music publishers), not necessarily straight to the artists themselves.

derived.claim: The remaining roughly 30% (100% minus 70%) is what Spotify keeps to cover its own costs and profit.
say: about thirty cents on the dollar
